Specification: This module is a TLC model wrapper for the DijkstraMutex specification. It introduces four model-value constants p1, p2, p3, and p4, defines the process set Proc as the explicit set {p1, p2, p3, p4}, and maps the model behavior to the imported Spec operator and the model invariant to the imported MutualExclusion operator from the extended module. The file itself does not define the mutex algorithm, actions, or temporal properties internally; it only provides model-specific constants and aliases for checking the imported specification and invariant.
